sentences.en: After you finish shopping, remember to check out at the cashier.
sentences.zh: 购物结束后，别忘了去收银台付账。

sentences.en: Before leaving the hotel, make sure to check out your room with the receptionist.
sentences.zh: 离开酒店前，记得和前台确认一下房间。

sentences.en: Check out this new restaurant downtown; it has great reviews online.
sentences.zh: 可以去市中心这家新餐馆看看；网上评价不错。
